verdict.headline: Three-dissenter Fed minutes arrive today as Seoul's chip rout reaches Wall Street
verdict.label: FOMC Minutes (2pm ET) binary swing event; 3 of 4 regime indicators breached; Seoul semi rout pre-market
verdict.rationale_short: The July 28–29 FOMC Minutes (14:00 ET) land with three dissenters — Hammack, Kashkari, Logan — who voted for a 25bps hike, and nine of 18 FOMC members penciling in a 2026 increase. September hike odds sit at ~31%. The defining read is the character of the dissent: fiscal-sustainability dissent (Treasury supply absorption, deficit trajectory) has no ceiling from soft demand data and pushes the 30Y toward 5.40%; inflation-persistence-only dissent allows five consecutive soft CPI prints to temper further 30Y extension and targets a retrace below 5.25%. Overnight, South Korea's KOSPI fell ~4.6% as SK Hynix shed 9.93% and Samsung lost 7.54%, tracking the US semiconductor rout and adding a pre-market headwind that flows directly into NVDA, AMD, AMAT, and TSM. On Hormuz: the June MOU officially expired Monday (Aug 18) and Trump confirmed no Iran talks are occurring; Brent holds above $91 with the physical-disruption premium entrenched. Futures are fractionally green (+0.05–0.12%) suggesting the 'no talks' announcement was priced in — the live variable is the Minutes. Step aside into the 2pm release; reassess on the 30Y reaction.

trade_setups.thesis: Three dissenters (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) voted to hike at July 28–29. The Minutes' framing of that dissent is the day's definitive variable. Fiscal-sustainability dissent (driven by Treasury supply absorption and deficit trajectory) has no natural ceiling from five consecutive soft CPI prints and extends the 30Y toward 5.40%. Inflation-persistence-only dissent allows the soft data to constrain the move; 30Y retraces to 5.20–5.25% support. The 10Y's easing to 4.70% today is pre-Minutes tentative; the 2pm reaction overwrites it.
trade_setups.entry: 5.30% current (trigger 5.28% breached); 5.40% is the next technically meaningful level on fiscal-sustainability read; 5.20–5.25% is retracement support on benign dissent.
trade_setups.invalidation: Minutes reveal isolated inflation-persistence dissent only; 30Y retraces below 5.25% by Thursday open.

trade_setups.asset: US semiconductor complex — Seoul rout read-through
trade_setups.thesis: SK Hynix (–9.93%) and Samsung (–7.54%) in Seoul are the overnight proxy for the US AI/HBM hardware complex. The sell-off traces back to elevated US yields and renewed Hormuz risk premium weighing on global growth expectations — not a demand-specific revision. NVDA's Aug 26 earnings remain the fundamental clearing event; the near-term setup is open-auction pressure from the Seoul rout. Two consecutive US sessions closing below SPX 7,650 would confirm the rout is transmitting beyond Asia.
trade_setups.entry: NVDA ~$225; AMD ~$506; TSM ~$430. Watch the open-auction to see if $484 (AMD) and $220 (NVDA) hold.
trade_setups.invalidation: NVDA, AMD, TSM all recover above prior-day close within the first 30 minutes of trading — Seoul weakness was not transmitted.

trade_setups.asset: Brent Crude — MOU expiry premium lock-in
trade_setups.thesis: The June MOU expired Monday (Aug 18) with Trump explicitly confirming no Iran talks. Brent above $91 is now pricing an entrenched physical-disruption premium, not speculative ceasefire-expiry risk. The next catalyst is either a confirmed second physical interdiction event (extends toward $94–96) or back-channel Oman-mediated contact resuming (compresses toward $87–89). The absence of a follow-on strike within 48h is the precondition for any meaningful correction.
trade_setups.entry: $91.50 current; $94–96 on physical escalation; $87–89 on back-channel re-engagement.
trade_setups.invalidation: No further Hormuz physical incidents within 48h AND confirmed Oman back-channel contact; Brent retraces below $89.

bear_case: The June MOU expiry converts Hormuz from a negotiation-failure risk (compressible on diplomacy) to a structural physical-disruption premium with no diplomatic off-ramp visible. If the FOMC Minutes reveal that three dissenters were primarily motivated by fiscal sustainability and Treasury supply absorption — not merely CPI persistence — the 30Y has a path to 5.40%+ that five consecutive soft CPI prints cannot close. At 5.40% on the 30Y, duration-sensitive mega-cap (MSFT, META, GOOGL) reprices materially, and the AI capex-to-revenue question for NVDA becomes sharper going into August 26. Seoul's semiconductor session (-9.93% SK Hynix) is the early signal of that repricing. If SPX closes below 7,650 before the FOMC Minutes reaction is fully digested, the base-to-bear ratio flips: three regime indicators remain breached, 30Y is at or above the 5.28% trigger, and oil is pricing physical interdiction. BTC below $62,000 would close the last remaining non-breached regime indicator and confirm a full regime breach configuration.
